related.title: 大型砂模鑄造
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：雙側餘量沒有漏算，正向回算閉合，局部拘束與材料資料仍需獨立驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Both allowances are included, forward propagation closes, and local restraint/material evidence remains independently required.
related.difference: 從外模、砂心與基準偏移推算最薄壁，建立可辨認偏心與整體縮放的量測計畫。
related.differenceEn: Infer minimum wall from mold, core and datum offset, distinguishing eccentricity from global scale error.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 連續比例變化需相乘；模具尺寸=(成品+單邊餘量總和)/[(1−蠟縮)(1−金屬縮)]。 教學成品外寬 50.0 mm，雙側各 0.5 mm 餘量，蠟縮 0.5%、金屬縮 1.5%。 模具寬=51/(0.995×0.985)=52.0368 mm；按兩階段正向回算得 51.0 mm 鑄件。這是假定均勻自由收縮。
圓形同心殼的名義壁厚=(外徑−內徑)/2；砂心橫移 e 使一側減 e、對側增 e。 合成外徑 500 mm、砂心直徑 460 mm、偏心 3 mm；教學最低壁厚要求 18 mm。 名義厚度 20 mm，最薄 20−3=17 mm，最厚 23 mm；最薄比教學下限少 1 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Sequential ratios multiply; tool size=(finished size+total allowance)/[(1−wax shrink)(1−metal shrink)]. Teaching finished width 50.0 mm, 0.5 mm allowance per side, wax shrink 0.5%, metal shrink 1.5%. Tool width=51/(0.995×0.985)=52.0368 mm; forward propagation returns a 51.0 mm casting. Uniform unconstrained shrinkage is assumed.

For a concentric circular shell nominal wall=(OD−ID)/2; core shift e removes e on one side and adds e opposite. Synthetic OD 500 mm, core diameter 460 mm and eccentricity 3 mm; teaching minimum wall 18 mm. Nominal wall is 20 mm; minimum 17 mm and maximum 23 mm, leaving the minimum 1 mm below the teaching gate.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 精密滾動軸承製造
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：雙側餘量沒有漏算，正向回算閉合，局部拘束與材料資料仍需獨立驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Both allowances are included, forward propagation closes, and local restraint/material evidence remains independently required.
related.difference: 正確把百萬轉換成小時，說明 L10 是群體統計額定值而非個別保證。
related.differenceEn: Convert million revolutions to hours and explain L10 as a population rating rather than an individual guarantee.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 連續比例變化需相乘；模具尺寸=(成品+單邊餘量總和)/[(1−蠟縮)(1−金屬縮)]。 教學成品外寬 50.0 mm，雙側各 0.5 mm 餘量，蠟縮 0.5%、金屬縮 1.5%。 模具寬=51/(0.995×0.985)=52.0368 mm；按兩階段正向回算得 51.0 mm 鑄件。這是假定均勻自由收縮。
球軸承基本額定壽命 L10=(C/P)^3 百萬轉，L10h=10^6L10/(60n)；它對應模型條件下90%可靠度的滾動疲勞額定值，其他失效機制未含。 教學 C=30 kN、等效動載荷P=10 kN、轉速n=1000 rpm；球軸承而非滾子。 L10=27百萬轉；L10h=27×10^6/(60×1000)=450 h。未計污染、潤滑及安裝因素。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Sequential ratios multiply; tool size=(finished size+total allowance)/[(1−wax shrink)(1−metal shrink)]. Teaching finished width 50.0 mm, 0.5 mm allowance per side, wax shrink 0.5%, metal shrink 1.5%. Tool width=51/(0.995×0.985)=52.0368 mm; forward propagation returns a 51.0 mm casting. Uniform unconstrained shrinkage is assumed.

For ball bearings L10=(C/P)^3 million revolutions and L10 h=10^6 L10/(60 n). This basic rolling-fatigue rating corresponds to 90% reliability under model assumptions; other failure modes are excluded. Teaching C 30 kN, equivalent dynamic load P 10 kN, speed 1000 rpm; ball bearings, not rollers. L10=27 million revolutions; L10 h=450 h, without contamination, lubrication or installation adjustments.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
